title: pseudoclausia olgae
intro: Pseudoclausia olgae, commonly known as the "Russian valerian", is a type of flowering plant that belongs to the valerian family (Valerianaceae). This plant is used in traditional medicine due to its health benefits, which include sedative and anxiolytic properties that help in reducing stress and promoting relaxation. The therapeutic actions of Pseudoclausia olgae are attributed to its ability to interact with the GABA receptors in the brain, leading to a calming effect on the nervous system. The bioactive constituents of Pseudoclausia olgae include valerenic acid, valeranone, and isovaleric acid, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
